research_mode: official Ministry of Justice and HMPPS accredited statistics; fail-closed limitations; no parcel score, candidate value or business result

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Prison population since April 2021
verified_claims: The prison population on 31 March 2026 was around 9,500, or 12%, higher than at the end of April 2021.
limitations: Long-term prison-population growth is context for custody rates and not a local property-safety indicator.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Assault incidents and rate
verified_claims: There were 31,345 assaults in the 12 months to December 2025, a rate of 360 per 1,000 prisoners and a 2.7% annual increase in the rate.
limitations: Custodial assault rates do not measure public-space crime or parcel-level safety.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Latest-quarter assaults
verified_claims: The latest quarter recorded 7,499 assaults, down 8%, while the rate fell 7% to 86 per 1,000 prisoners.
limitations: Quarterly prison-assault movement is not a geographic crime trend.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Prisoner-on-prisoner assaults
verified_claims: There were 21,463 prisoner-on-prisoner assaults in the latest 12 months, a rate of 247 per 1,000 prisoners and a 6% annual increase in the rate.
limitations: The measure is specific to prison custody and cannot be mapped to residents or parcels.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Latest-quarter prisoner-on-prisoner assaults
verified_claims: Prisoner-on-prisoner assaults fell 10% to 5,125 incidents in the latest quarter.
limitations: One-quarter custodial change is too context-specific for local safety scoring.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Assaults on staff
verified_claims: There were 10,142 assaults on staff in the 12 months to December 2025, a rate of 117 per 1,000 prisoners and a 4.5% annual decrease in the rate.
limitations: Workplace violence within prisons is not equivalent to community or parcel safety.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Latest-quarter staff assaults
verified_claims: Assaults on staff decreased 4.6% to 2,446 incidents in the latest quarter.
limitations: The quarterly institutional count cannot identify risks around a specific property.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Serious assaults
verified_claims: There were 3,484 serious assaults in the latest 12 months, a rate of 40 per 1,000 prisoners and a 2.8% annual increase in the rate.
limitations: Serious-assault definitions and prison exposure differ from police-recorded community violence.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Serious-assault breakdown
verified_claims: Serious prisoner-on-prisoner assaults increased 6% to 2,610 incidents and a rate of 30 per 1,000, while serious assaults on staff decreased 6% to 908 incidents and a rate of 10.
limitations: Subcategory rates remain institutional and cannot be promoted to parcel evidence.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Covid-period comparability warning
verified_claims: The publication says comparability between 2020 and 2022 and other periods is affected by prison restrictions used to control Covid-19.
limitations: The structural break requires cautious time-series interpretation and blocks naive trend extrapolation to local parcels.
